function: Channel estimation: learned selection of active RIS elements and extrapolation of the full time-varying BS-RIS and RIS-UE channels from partial LS estimates (pp. 3-4).
system: Hybrid RIS (reflecting, a subset of elements active), N=64 (8x8); BS and UE 2 antennas each; OFDM 64 subcarriers, 50 MHz; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 8).
method: Supervised end-to-end deep networks: CNN scorer with differentiable perturbed Top-N RIS-element selection (RESM) plus improved-transformer and residual-block extrapolation network (FCEM); Huber loss (pp. 4-7).
data_channel: Time-varying channels from the paper's Section II model on DeepMIMO outdoor scenario O1 (BS1 as BS, BS4 as RIS), 5 paths; 7:3 train/test split (p. 8).
test_conditions: One 7:3 train/test split of the dataset; defaults v=100 km/h, Ns=8, SNR=20 dB; sweeps of SNR, speed 0-400 km/h, Ns 4-32; retraining per point not stated (pp. 8-11).
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE, random/block/stripe/structural element selection. Learned: DPS [20], ODE [23], [28] (with RESM added), DPSF, own CES without attention (pp. 9-10).
metrics: NMSE (dB) versus SNR, training epochs, number of selected RIS elements, and user speed; selected-element maps (pp. 8-11).
complexity: Analytical order O(N^2 + (M+P)N Ns K + (M+P)^2 K + (M+P)N K^2) for RESM plus FCEM; no measured runtime or parameter count (pp. 7-8).
q1_support: p. 8: "from the Wireless InSite-based DeepMIMO dataset [24]" (outdoor scenario O1, used to generate the experimental dataset).
q2_support: p. 8: "The generated dataset is divided into training and test sets in a ratio 7:3." Missing: no model trained in one scenario, speed, SNR or Ns is tested in another; the sweeps (Figs. 6, 11, 12) do not say whether each point is retrained, and no fine-tuning or transfer is reported.
q3_support: p. 9: "LMMSE is used as a baseline for comparison with the DL algorithm"; p. 9: "(DPS) based method [20] and ordinary differential equations (ODE) based method [23], [28]". All compared on NMSE (Figs. 6, 11, 12).
q4_support: p. 8: "the total complexity of the proposed scheme is the sum of the complexities of RESM and FCEM", given as the order O(N^2 + (M + P)N Ns K + (M + P)^2 K + (M + P)N K^2).
q5_support: p. 8: "from the Wireless InSite-based DeepMIMO dataset [24]" (public DeepMIMO channels). The paper gives no link to its own code or data.
notes: Included, area 2: RIS element selection serves the channel estimation and the main metric is NMSE. The RIS is hybrid, with only Ns elements activated (p. 3). q1 and q5: the time-varying part comes from the paper's own Doppler model (Eq. 3) applied over DeepMIMO O1 paths, and the carrier frequency of O1 is not given, so the reviewer may confirm. Figs. 6-12 are images; NMSE values were read from the page images. Table I (p. 7) lists convolution settings only, not a parameter count.
